data.name: A Detective's Novel
data.detailed_description:
On a cold November night in a desolate estate deep in the mountains an innocent life has prematurely perished. Surrounded only by his family and closest friends, a controversial yet immensely successful businessman William Goldberg passed away under mysterious circumstances. Being an upstanding member of society and the owner of Goldberg Industries, a multi-million dollar arms company responsible for providing the military during the World War 2, news of his death caused an uproar at the local police department. It seemed the case was tailor-made for the legendary detective Knox, a prodigy who successfully solved over hundred cases. Accompanied by an aspiring young detective Clark assigned by the Chief to keep an eye on him, Knox departs towards the Goldberg's estate to discover the truth behind the incident.

Miles away from nearest settlement in a mansion hidden from the eyes of public, it is only natural to presume that only those present at the time could have been involved. Follow clues, look for evidence and discover key information by interrogating the suspects. All pieces of the puzzle will be presented and it's up to you to deduce who, how and why the murder happened. A mystery visual novel inspired by classic novels from Arthur C. Doyle and Agatha Christie and "When They Cry" series.

CHARACTERS



Age: 29
Profession: Senior Detective
Blood type: B

One of the most famous detectives in the entire state, Knox has yet to stumble upon a mystery he is unable to unravel. Despite his young age, he decisively solved over 100 cases. A prodigy by nature, he rarely puts any effort in his detective work often neglecting it to enjoy cigarettes and coffee.




Age: 26
Profession: Junior Detective
Blood Type: A

A young and naive detective working on his first case, eager to prove himself. According to Knox he is a narrow minded simpleton sent by the Chief to ensure Knox plays by the book.




Age: 32
Profession: Ex-Soldier 1st Class
Blood Type: 0

Eldest son of the deceased who has just returned from the Second Great War. His intellect and bravery allowed him to prove his worth on the front lines in the Pacific. Being the eldest heir, he is the first in line to inherit his father's fortune.




Age: 58
Profession: Businessman
Blood Type: 0

Well established businessman and a close friend of the deceased. He helped Goldberg create his financial empire during the war. Despite his short temper his charisma makes him beloved by his employees.



Age:35
Profession: Housewife
Blood Type: AB

The widow of the deceased. Although their marriage lasted very short she claims that she loved the deceased deeply. Ms. Goldberg is a very emotional person that can change her attitude very quickly if provoked.



Age: 65
Profession: Butler
Blood Type: B

The family butler that has served the Goldbergs for decades. Calm and patient man which despite his old age still chooses to work instead of retiring.

reviews.review:
A Detective’s Novel is a mystery-focused visual novel developed and published by Amaterasu Software that embraces the traditions of classic detective fiction. Set within an isolated mountain estate following the suspicious death of a wealthy businessman, the game places players in the role of following a brilliant young investigator as he searches for the truth hidden among a cast of suspects. Rather than depending on action sequences or elaborate gameplay systems, the experience is built around storytelling, logical deduction, and the gradual uncovering of secrets. From the opening moments, the game establishes a tense atmosphere where every conversation feels important and every character seems capable of hiding something.

The narrative revolves around Detective Knox, a gifted investigator with a remarkable record of solved cases despite his youth. Accompanied by his assistant Clark, he arrives at the Goldberg residence to examine what initially appears to be a straightforward murder. As the investigation unfolds, however, layers of deception begin to emerge. Family disputes, personal grudges, concealed motives, and conflicting testimonies create a web of uncertainty that keeps the mystery engaging. The game successfully captures the spirit of traditional whodunit stories by encouraging players to pay attention to details and consider the evidence presented throughout the case.

One of the strongest aspects of the game is its commitment to detective work. Information is revealed through interviews, observations, and discussions rather than through combat or exploration-heavy mechanics. The story frequently challenges players to think critically about what they have learned, making the process of reaching the final solution feel rewarding. While the game does not feature highly complex puzzle systems, it does a respectable job of making players feel involved in the investigation. Fans of classic mystery novels will appreciate how the narrative focuses on logic and deduction rather than relying on supernatural twists or excessive action.

The cast plays an important role in maintaining suspense. Each suspect contributes to the overall intrigue, and the story gradually exposes hidden aspects of their personalities and relationships. Detective Knox serves as an effective protagonist, possessing enough intelligence and confidence to drive the investigation forward while remaining interesting to follow. Clark acts as a useful companion who helps balance the narrative and provides a different perspective on events. Although some supporting characters receive more attention than others, the ensemble as a whole succeeds in creating a believable mystery environment where trust becomes increasingly difficult.

Visually, A Detective’s Novel adopts a simple but functional presentation. Character portraits and backgrounds are designed to support the narrative rather than dominate it, and they effectively establish the atmosphere of a secluded estate cut off from the outside world. The artwork may not be particularly ambitious compared to larger visual novels, but it remains consistent and appropriate for the story being told. The focus remains firmly on dialogue and investigation, which allows the narrative to take center stage.

The audio presentation follows a similar philosophy. The soundtrack provides a steady sense of tension and mystery without becoming distracting, helping key moments feel more impactful. Music cues are used effectively to emphasize revelations and dramatic confrontations. While the production values are relatively modest, the combination of sound and visuals succeeds in creating an immersive detective story that remains engaging throughout its runtime.

The game is not without shortcomings. Its relatively short length means that certain characters and subplots could have benefited from additional development. Experienced mystery fans may also recognize some familiar genre conventions and predict a few developments before they occur. Furthermore, players seeking extensive branching paths, multiple endings, or deep gameplay mechanics may find the experience somewhat limited. The title is designed primarily as a focused narrative adventure, and its appeal depends heavily on a player's appreciation for detective fiction.

Despite these limitations, A Detective’s Novel delivers an enjoyable mystery that remains faithful to the traditions that inspired it. Its carefully structured investigation, intriguing cast of suspects, and emphasis on deduction create a satisfying experience for fans of crime stories and visual novels. While it lacks the scale and polish of bigger genre releases, it compensates with a clear understanding of what makes a classic murder mystery compelling. For players who enjoy unraveling secrets, examining motives, and piecing together clues, the game offers several hours of engaging detective work.

Rating: 6/10
